baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم ... فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ... يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imagined protecting enclosure is not merely overpowered from outside. A cast force lands inside the heart, reverses agency, and makes the protected occupants destroy the dwelling they trusted.

activation_trace.role: Protective force supplies the occupants' theory of inaccessible safety.
An enclosing fortification materializes that theory as an inside sealed from danger.
A forceful cast crosses the supposed boundary and supplies the inward breach.
The heart is the interior landing site where exterior protection is reversed.
Fear supplies the affective force that redirects action from defense to self-damage.
Ruination of built space is the visible result of the inward reversal.
Attributing action to the hands makes the occupants' own deed, not only an external blow, causal.

changed_reading.before: Fortresses fail when a stronger outside force defeats them.
changed_reading.after: The decisive breach is inward: fear recruits the protected occupants' own agency, so protection turns itself into self-destruction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا ظَنَنتُمْ ... وَظَنُّوا ... لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا ... فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Two failed forecasts and an uncounted route culminate in an imperative to cross from the visible case to its intelligible pattern. Surprise is therefore the lesson's operating method, not incidental drama.

activation_trace.role: The paired imaginings place observers and occupants inside different but equally failed projections.
Counting and calculation supply the missing category: the effective route was outside their reckoned set.
Crossing from side to side gives the imperative a spatial model for leaving the first impression.
Taking one witnessed condition as instruction for another makes the crossing explicitly analogical.
Inner discernment, beyond eyesight alone, is the faculty required to complete the crossing.

changed_reading.before: A surprising expulsion is followed by a general command to take heed.
changed_reading.after: The event is an epistemic exercise: expose failed forecasts, locate the omitted cause, then carry the visible case across into a reusable judgment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated instrument 'hands' places occupants and believers in one grammatical channel of demolition while preserving opposed allegiances. Divine action works through a coupled chain: inwardly induced self-action and externally completed action.

activation_trace.role: The literal paired hands make both parties concrete instruments in the same action.
Hand-attribution intensifies personal responsibility for the occupants' share of the destruction.
The helping hand keeps the believers' contribution distinct as completing force rather than self-harm.
Settled conviction differentiates the second set of hands from the terror-driven first set.
One ruined object receives the otherwise opposed agencies.

changed_reading.before: The victors destroy enemy houses, with some incidental help from the occupants.
changed_reading.after: The doubled hands disclose nested agency: self-collapse and opposing action are coordinated instruments of one outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ... مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا ... فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering, extraction, an indeterminate route, and the exposed heart form a disclosure sequence. The outward exit manifests concealed dependence on walls and concealed fear through visible acts of the hands.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the concealed condition from which the sequence begins.
Bringing something out of hiddenness lets physical expulsion also function as exposure.
The indefinite place withholds the route while its effects become visible.
The formerly inaccessible interior is named as the decisive site.
The hands publicly render the inner collapse as attributable action.

changed_reading.before: People are physically removed from concealed safety inside their homes.
changed_reading.after: Removal is also disclosure: hidden trust and fear are brought out until the hands make the inward condition publicly legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ ... فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Beginning, gathered movement, outcome, and analogical consideration make the event more than a dated first. It can be read as an initial specimen whose ending is meant to be carried into later cases.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence establish the event as an initial instance.
Return to outcome supplies a live secondary horizon for what the first instance points toward.
Driving and gathering a group gives the initial instance a directed collective shape.
The closing imperative asks that this condition be made a measure for another.
Discernment identifies the pattern carried beyond the first occurrence.

changed_reading.before: 'First gathering' is primarily a chronological label for this removal.
changed_reading.after: It is also the first readable case in a sequence: a gathered event whose outcome trains later recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah names exile as something written by God. That turns the unreckoned arrival and exit in 59:2 from a contingent breach into the execution of an already fixed disposition.

activation_trace.role: Passage outside the prior abode is the focus event to be revised.
Binding inscription that imposes decree makes the exit an enacted determination.
Exile from the homeland identifies the concrete disposition written for them.

structural_cues: 59:3 immediately restates the event as a written جلاء and contrasts it with a worldly punishment not imposed in that form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written determination plus exile; I infer decree -> the surprise in 59:2 concerns human access to the cause, not contingency in the cause. A live alternative is that 59:3 only distinguishes exile from another punishment without redescribing the breach mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An unforeseeable military turn happens to force an exit.
changed_reading.after: The unforeseeable turn executes a written exit: hidden from calculation does not mean causally unformed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cut/leave contrast gives destruction a pruning grammar. Built form may be removed while selected living structures remain upright on their bases, revising 'destroying houses' away from an undifferentiated image of erasure.

activation_trace.role: Ruination of habitation is the focus action whose scope is being differentiated.
The dwelling supplies the constructed object affected by unbuilding.
Severing supplies one authorized mode of removal.
Leaving a thing in its condition supplies the opposed mode of preservation.
Standing bodily gives preservation a visible upright state.
The base or root marks what may remain even when other growth is cut.

structural_cues: 59:5 coordinates cutting and leaving with أو, then specifies what is left as standing on its roots.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled contrast of cutting versus rooted standing; I infer that contrast -> a material analogy for 59:2's destruction. The live alternative is that the tree ruling is adjacent but does not qualify the semantics of the houses.

changed_reading.before: The houses are simply reduced to total ruin.
changed_reading.after: The episode can carry selective unbuilding: fortified possession is dismantled without making indiscriminate erasure the governing image.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expulsion removes property from the fortified private hand; the ensuing return and anti-circulation-among-the-rich rule route it into a deliberately widened social circuit. Spatial opening becomes economic deconcentration.

activation_trace.role: Exit from the prior enclosure supplies the spatial displacement.
The owning hand makes possession a latent dimension of the repeated hands.
Return and reversion reclassify the resulting property as something redirected rather than merely captured.
Movement between hands and conditions supplies the circulation that the distribution rule constrains.

structural_cues: 59:6 denies cavalry and mounted exertion as the acquisition mechanism.
59:7 lists recipients and states that the property must not circulate only among the rich.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversion, absent conventional acquisition effort, and regulated circulation; I infer expulsion -> property exits one fortified hand and enters a social circuit. A live alternative limits these verses to a technical allocation rule without making circulation part of 59:2's image.

changed_reading.before: The event transfers houses and goods from defeated holders to victors.
changed_reading.after: The broken enclosure initiates anti-concentration: possession is made to return and circulate beyond another closed wealthy hand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Destroyed exclusive dwelling is answered by a social dwelling made through reception, migration, preference for others, and resistance to possessive withholding. The believers' hands therefore open a constructive horizon beyond their role in demolition.

activation_trace.role: Household and family make the destroyed house a social container as well as a building.
The helping hand keeps a constructive capacity latent in the believers' named hands.
Making a settled abode supplies the positive counterpart to expulsion and destroyed dwelling.
Movement from one home to another identifies those received into the new social space.
Choosing others over oneself supplies the allocation rule by which shared dwelling is made.
Greedy withholding is the inward enclosure that must be warded off for re-dwelling to work.

structural_cues: 59:8 repeats expulsion from homes and adds loss of wealth.
59:9 joins settling the home with faith, love of migrants, and preference despite scarcity.
59:10 extends the rebuilt community across time by asking that rancor be removed from hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displaced people, hosts who make an abode, and anti-withholding preference; I infer demolished exclusive house -> reconstructed shared home. A live alternative treats the hosting sequence as ethical aftermath rather than a completion of the house image.

changed_reading.before: The believers' hands terminate an enemy household order by helping destroy its houses.
changed_reading.after: Those hands stand at a threshold between unhousing and re-housing: closed possession is broken, then dwelling is rebuilt through reception and preference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised alliance is a second fortress with a concealed exit. Its speakers announce co-exit and support, but their hidden egress, false speech, and turned backs leave the occupants to the self-collapse already visible in 59:2.

activation_trace.role: Protective force is the common function claimed first by walls and then by allies.
The physical enclosure supplies the model extended to social protection.
Showing one opening while hiding another gives the alliance an architectural mechanism of deceptive escape.
Falsehood voids the spoken promises of shared exit and aid.
Turning away converts promised nearness and support into withdrawal.
Presenting the back makes the alliance's exit visible at the moment protection is needed.

structural_cues: 59:11 promises 'if you are expelled, we will go out with you' and 'we will support you.'
59:12 repeats each condition only to negate co-exit, aid, and enduring support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an alliance that speaks like a protective enclosure but preserves an escape route; I infer alliance-as-fortress -> 59:2's failed defenses include social architecture. A live alternative keeps the allies as a parallel betrayal without folding them into the fortress mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The occupants misjudge only the defensive capacity of masonry.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit nested false defenses: walls cannot keep danger out, and allied promises contain a hidden exit that lets support drain away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context exposes the cross-section of the fortress: fear in breasts, combat from behind walls, severe force circulating internally, and hearts dispersed beneath an appearance of unity. This explains how enclosure redirects strength into self-ruin.

activation_trace.role: The heart is the interior whose later fragmentation explains the focus collapse.
Fear initiates the inward redirection of action.
Ruined houses are the material output of that inwardly redirected force.
Fear with contraction locates the pressure in their breasts and clarifies its constricting operation.
The high wall preserves exterior separation while concealing the interior condition.
Overpowering severity supplies force that is directed among themselves rather than coherently outward.
Scattering names the hidden state of the hearts beneath apparent collectedness.

structural_cues: 59:14 places fighting in fortified settlements or behind walls beside severe internal force.
'You calculate them together, but their hearts are scattered' repeats 59:2's contrast between reckoned appearance and inward reality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wall-backed appearance, inward fear, internal severity, and scattered hearts; I infer fragmentation -> force turns against the group's own built order. A live alternative is that internal discord explains military weakness without directly causing the house destruction.

changed_reading.before: Fear produces a sudden, largely undifferentiated panic inside strong defenses.
changed_reading.after: The walls conceal a divided interior: fear contracts, hearts scatter, and trapped severity turns inward until the enclosure consumes itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence explicitly places the episode beside a recent predecessor and then beside inducement followed by disavowal. The first gathering becomes one instance of a repeatable alliance-collapse-outcome pattern that fulfills the command to consider.

activation_trace.role: Firstness positions the focus episode as an initial readable instance.
Making one condition a lesson for another supplies the transfer operation.
A likeness functioning as lesson explicitly turns adjacent history into a comparable case.
Disavowal and separation supply the recurring moment when a prompting ally abandons the induced actor.
The ending or consequence closes the repeated mechanism for both parties.

structural_cues: 59:15 begins with 'like those shortly before them.'
59:16 begins with a second likeness and stages command, compliance, and abandonment.
59:17 gives the two actors one outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit likenesses and a shared ending; I infer these cases -> the 'first' event is a portable causal pattern, not merely a date. A live alternative is that the likenesses only reinforce culpability and outcome, leaving أول الحشر strictly chronological.

changed_reading.before: The audience should remember a singular historical defeat.
changed_reading.after: The audience should detect a recurring mechanism: apparent support induces commitment, support separates at crisis, and the shared outcome reveals the first confidence as false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Looking at what the self sends ahead and the warning that forgetting produces self-forgetting make the unreckoned arrival retrospectively legible. The future seems to come from elsewhere, yet one's own uninspected acts have already forwarded it.

activation_trace.role: Failed calculation names the inability to include the effective route and consequence.
The hands reveal that the surprised actors materially participate in producing the result.
Directed sight and insight supply the prospective audit that was absent in the focus miscalculation.
Sending something forward makes present action an advance cause awaiting the self tomorrow.
Loss of remembered attention explains how self-produced consequences become experientially unexpected.
The self as the thing itself makes self-forgetting a loss of access to one's own causal participation.

structural_cues: 59:18 orders each self to inspect what it has sent ahead for tomorrow.
59:19 gives forgetting God the reflexive consequence of being made to forget oneself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prospective self-audit, forwarded action, and reflexive forgetting; I infer own acts -> the route from 'where they did not calculate.' A live alternative treats 59:18-19 as a new exhortation rather than a causal rereading of the earlier surprise.

changed_reading.before: God's arrival is unexpected because its source lies wholly outside the actors' causal field.
changed_reading.after: It is also unexpected because they cannot read their own forwarded acts: what comes from an unreckoned direction arrives through consequences their own hands helped prepare.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hypothetical mountain makes hard exterior form legible as a body of inward response. Read beside it, fortress and house are not neutral shells: the condition of the interior determines whether solidity lowers, splits, or is destroyed through its inhabitants.

activation_trace.role: The enclosing fortification supplies the hard built form placed under pressure.
The heart anchors the claim that built response and inward response are coupled.
Perforation or rupture supplies the material failure that can be compared with splitting.
A high solid mass supplies the maximal natural analogue to the fortress.
Lowering and submission give the solid exterior an inwardly responsive posture.
A hard thing splitting open supplies the visible material consequence of that response.
Fear joined with awe differentiates responsive fracture from the terror-driven collapse in the focus.

structural_cues: 59:21 hypothetically joins revelation, a mountain, inward lowering, and visible splitting, then labels such constructions examples for thought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two hard enclosures with affective interiors and material rupture; I infer mountain response <-> fortress response as a contrastive analogy. A live alternative is that the mountain example concerns receptivity to revelation only and should not be mapped back onto the houses.

changed_reading.before: Fortress and house are passive scenery around psychological fear.
changed_reading.after: Architecture becomes an exteriorized response-body: inward orientation propagates into material form, whether as humbled splitting or terror-driven self-ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing names gather safety, heart-settling security, sovereignty, and oversight in God. This converts trust in protective fortresses from a weak tactical estimate into a category error about where security and control reside.

activation_trace.role: Protective power is the predicate incorrectly lodged in the fortresses.
The surrounding wall is the finite container asked to bear that predicate.
Safety and freedom from harm relocate the desired condition from architecture to a divine name.
Settled security and trust relocate the inward state that the walls failed to provide.
Sovereignty supplies the encompassing control against which local possession cannot be a barrier.
Witnessing guardianship supplies oversight that reaches the interior hidden by walls.

structural_cues: 59:22-24 repeat 'He is God' and close the surah by naming divine knowledge, kingship, peace, security, oversight, might, creation, and formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing concentration of protective and sovereign predicates in God; I infer this closure -> 59:2 diagnoses misplaced security, not merely insufficient fortification. A live alternative reads the names as general doxology without assigning each one a retrospective contrast.

changed_reading.before: One defensive power is defeated by a stronger attacking power.
changed_reading.after: The occupants make a category mistake: walls can enclose bodies, but safety, sovereignty, and interior oversight were never predicates the walls could own.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant fullness image of رعب rather than treating terror only as emotion. It remains anchored in terror being cast into hearts and followed by perforation and house-ruin. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for pressure, never as a replacement gloss for الرعب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ ... يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies a material entry into the interior.
The heart supplies the receiving basin for the analogy.
Filling a basin or valley supplies the exploratory image of fear accumulating as inward pressure.
Perforation supplies the pressure-release image that becomes visible in the dwelling.

changed_reading.before: An emotion is inserted and then causes panicked demolition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, cast terror fills the inward basin until pressure seeks an outlet by perforating the trusted enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the motion/swimming branch of the surah's framing تسبيح as a spatial analogy. It remains anchored in repeated exit, gathering, and failed static enclosure in 59:2, while 59:1 and 59:24 frame all creation in تسبيح. Render it as an exploratory frame about motion versus fixity, not as the lexical meaning of the expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Passing outside supplies forced movement out of the fixed enclosure.
Driven collective movement supplies the directed course of that exit.
The surrounding fortification supplies the resisted ideal of static sealedness.
Running or swimming supplies an opening cosmic image of continuous motion.
The repeated motion image at the close contains the forced exit within the same frame.

changed_reading.before: A static stronghold is breached and its occupants are moved for military reasons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, trust in fixity is broken by forced participation in a wider directed motion that already frames the surah.

strongest_changes: Fortress failure became an inward causal inversion: fear fragments hearts and turns occupants into agents of their own unhousing.
Exit and demolished possession became a transfer from enclosed ownership into return, circulation, and shared social dwelling.
The imperative to consider, later likenesses, and future self-audit recast 59:2 as a repeatable model of unrecognized consequences.
The closing divine names relocate security, sovereignty, and interior oversight from walls to God.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah tightly chains spatial enclosure, epistemic miscalculation, affective entry, and hand-mediated self-destruction. The context then reactivates each axis in economic, social, analogical, temporal, and material registers without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain how far أول الحشر itself licenses the prototype/outcome reading beyond chronological firstness.
The pruning, mountain, fear-flood, and cosmic-motion models are analogical activations, not proposed lexical substitutions.
The return-and-circulation sequence clearly governs resulting property, but its direct reach back into the image of destroyed houses remains inferential.
